name: smwgraphics-redrawn-big-bush
title: Redrawn Big Bush
description:
A redrawn version of the large bushes that commonly adorn grassland levels. Useful for hacks where you want the GFX to be realistic but still whimsical. In order for this to look right, the first two colored tiles in the palette they use must be changed to darker shades of green. Otherwise the bushes will look great and beautiful! PS: The colors of the bush seen in the screenshots below ARE included. Created by WeegeeBen. Drawn by hand. No credit required, but if you feel like you must, hey- I'm not gonna stop you.

Just take the tiles from the GFX file included and insert the palettes.
